title: 第1章 废土：文明堡垒
slug: 废土藏身处从下水道开始升级
content_zh:
1.废土世界，生存是你的唯一目标，所以请尽全力建造和隐藏你的藏身处，这是你能否活下去的唯一依仗。
2.生命只有一次，在游戏中死亡，你的存在将全部清除，破局办法请参考第一条提示。
3.不定期会触发特殊灾难事件，可能是自然天灾，也可能是极端事件，请小心留意。它们可能是你在废土生存最大的威胁，破局办法请参考第一条提示。
结果转头就在洗脚房捡到一封染血的信件，作为骨灰级玩家，他对游戏内的物品早就了如指掌。
但对这封信件却没一点印象，抱着好奇的心态点击打开，里面是一张不知所谓的废土游戏邀请函，选项更是只有简单的【是】与【否】。
再睁眼,人却已经出现在这个陌生的地方，再然后就是刚才看到的那些内容。
作为末日生存爱好者，他明白自己被某种存在选中，进入废土世界了。
他所在的地方应该是家牙医诊所，但明显被洗劫过，地上到处都是杂乱的脚印和破碎的玻璃碎片。
content_en:
1. In the wasteland world, survival is your only goal, so please do your best to build and hide your hideout. This is the only way you can survive.
2. You only have one life. If you die in the game, your existence will be cleared. Please refer to the first tip for how to break the game.
3. Special disaster events may be triggered from time to time, which may be natural disasters or extreme events, so please be careful. They may be the biggest threat to your survival in the wasteland. Please refer to the first tip to solve the problem.
As a result, he turned around and picked up a blood-stained letter in the foot washing room. As a hardcore player, he already knew the items in the game very well.
But I didn't have any impression of this letter, so I clicked to open it out of curiosity. Inside was an invitation to an unknown wasteland game, and the options were only a simple [Yes] or [No].
When he opened his eyes again, the person had already appeared in this strange place, and then there were the contents he had just seen.
As a doomsday survival enthusiast, he understood that he was selected by some kind of existence and entered the wasteland world.
The place where he was was supposed to be a dental clinic, but it had obviously been ransacked, with messy footprints and broken glass shards everywhere on the ground.
